A prequel to Turok: Dinosaur Hunter (1997), it was developed by Acclaim Studios Austin and published by Acclaim Entertainment. It was released for the PlayStation 2, Xbox and GameCube in 2002, alongside a handheld version for the Game Boy Advance. A port of the home console game was released for Windows in 2003, for the European market.

Switch:dokapon-kingdom.d: Dokapon Kingdom is a role-playing video game developed and published by Sting Entertainment for the PlayStation 2. The PlayStation 2 version was later re-released in Japan on November 20, 2008.

GB:samurai-shodown.d: Samurai Shodown is a 1993 fighting game developed and published by SNK for the Neo Geo arcade and home platforms. It is the first installment in the Samurai Shodown series. In contrast to most fighting games at the time, which were set in the modern age and focused primarily on hand-to-hand combat, Samurai Shodown takes place in feudal-era Japan (similar to Kaneko's Shogun Warriors that was released the year prior). It was SNK's first arcade fighting game to focus primarily on weapon-based combat.

GBC:klustar.d: Klustar is a 1999 Game Boy Color game developed by Rebellion Developments and published by Infogrames. Similar to Tetris, the game is a puzzle game requiring the player to manipulate and match patterns on a grid of blocks.

Gameplay consists of the player battling each computer-controlled opponent in up to three one-minute rounds and a scoring system based on the player's performance.
